arxiv-1801-05071.title: A Finite Block Length Achievability Bound for Low Probability of Detection Communication
arxiv-1801-05071.creator: Nick Letzepis
arxiv-1801-05071.description: Abstract Low probability of detection (or covert) communication refers to the scenario where information must be sent reliably to a receiver, but with low probability of detection by an adversary. Recent works on the fundamental limits of this communication problem have established achievability and converse bounds that are asymptotic in the block length of the code.

arxiv-2105-13472.title: How a Losing Team like the Canadiens can Steal a Stanley Cup: A Quantitative Intransitive Hockey Analysis
arxiv-2105-13472.creator: C. J. Barrett, S. Koumarianos, O. Mermut, York University (Toronto); McGill University (Montreal), Canada
arxiv-2105-13472.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by C. J. Barrett, S. Koumarianos, O. Mermut, York University (Toronto); McGill University (Montreal), Canada. We present here a simple mathematical model that provides a successful strategy, quantitatively, to ending the continued championship futility experienced by Canadian Hockey Teams.

arxiv-2109-10213.title: Blockchain-based Covid Vaccination Registration and Monitoring
arxiv-2109-10213.creator: Shirajus Salekin Nabil, Md. Sabbir Alam Pran, Ali Abrar Al Haque, Narayan Ranjan Chakraborty, Mohammad Jabed Morshed Chowdhury, Md Sadek Ferdous
arxiv-2109-10213.description: Abstract Covid-19 (SARS-CoV-2) has changed almost all the aspects of our living. Governments around the world have imposed lockdown to slow down the transmissions. In the meantime, researchers worked hard to find the vaccine. Fortunately, we have found the vaccine, in fact a good number of them.

arxiv-2111-15002.title: LEGS: Learning Efficient Grasp Sets for Exploratory Grasping
arxiv-2111-15002.creator: Letian Fu, Michael Danielczuk, Ashwin Balakrishna, Daniel S. Brown, Jeffrey Ichnowski, Eugen Solowjow, Ken Goldberg
arxiv-2111-15002.description: Abstract While deep learning has enabled significant progress in designing general purpose robot grasping systems, there remain objects which still pose challenges for these systems. Recent work on Exploratory Grasping has formalized the problem of systematically exploring grasps on these adversarial objects and explored a multi-armed bandit model for identifying high-quality grasps on each object stable pose.

arxiv-2112-03550.title: Tensor network approach to the two-dimensional fully frustrated XY model and a chiral ordered phase
arxiv-2112-03550.creator: Feng-Feng Song 1 and Guang-Ming Zhang 1,2
arxiv-2112-03550.description: Abstract A general framework is proposed to solve the two-dimensional fully frustrated XY model for the Josephson junction arrays in a perpendicular magnetic field. The essential idea is to encode the ground-state local rules induced by frustrations in the local tensors of the partition function.

arxiv-2205-09375.title: On the annual and semi-annual components of variations in extent of Arctic and Antarctic sea-ice
arxiv-2205-09375.creator: F. Lopes, V. Courtillot, D. Gibert, J-L. Le Mouël
arxiv-2205-09375.description: Abstract The time series (1978-2022) of northern hemisphere ( NHSI ) and southern hemisphere ( SHSI ) sea-ice extent are submitted to singular spectral analysis ( SSA ). The spectral components are analyzed with Laplace’s formulation of the Liouville-Euler system of differential equations. Laplace assumes that all masses on and in Earth are set into motion by astronomical forces.

arxiv-2211-01439.title: Inter model sets in ℝ d {\mathbb{R}}^{d} are model sets
arxiv-2211-01439.creator: Christoph Richard, Nicolae Strungaru
arxiv-2211-01439.description: Abstract . We show that any translate of a model set is a model set in some modified cut-and-project scheme. Restricting to Euclidean direct space, we show that any translate of an inter model set is a model set in some modified cut-and-project scheme with second countable internal space.

arxiv-2306-08028.title: The impact of baryonic potentials on the gravothermal evolution of self-interacting dark matter haloes 2023 The impact of baryonic potentials on the gravothermal evolution of self-interacting dark matter haloes – E
arxiv-2306-08028.creator: Yi-Ming Zhong, Daneng Yang, Hai-Bo Yu
arxiv-2306-08028.description: Abstract The presence of a central baryonic potential can have a significant impact on the gravothermal evolution of self-interacting dark matter (SIDM) haloes. We extend a semi-analytical fluid model to incorporate the influence of a static baryonic potential and calibrate it using controlled N-body simulations.

arxiv-2508-17473.title: A Consensus Algorithm for Second-Order Systems Evolving on Lie Groups
arxiv-2508-17473.creator: Akhil B Krishna, Farshad Khorrami, Anthony Tzes
arxiv-2508-17473.description: Abstract In this paper, a consensus algorithm is proposed for interacting multi-agents, which can be modeled as simple Mechanical Control Systems (MCS) evolving on a general Lie group. The standard Laplacian flow consensus algorithm for double integrator systems evolving on Euclidean spaces is extended to a general Lie group.

pmc-10747061.title: A Smart Real-Time Parking Control and Monitoring System
pmc-10747061.creator: Abdelrahman Osman Elfaki, Wassim Messoudi, Anas Bushnag, Shakour Abuzneid, Tareq Alhmiedat
pmc-10747061.description: Smart parking is an artificial intelligence-based solution to solve the challenges of inefficient utilization of parking slots, wasting time, congestion producing high CO2 emission levels, inflexible payment methods, and protecting parked vehicles from theft and vandalism. Nothing is worse than parking congestion caused by drivers looking for open spaces.

pmc-10776340.title: Anti-inflammatory Activities of Sulfated Polysaccharides From Ethanol Crude Extract of Spyrida Species Red Seaweed
pmc-10776340.creator: Shweta Mary Reddy, Vasugi Suresh, Sivaperumal Pitchiah, Balachandran Subramanian
pmc-10776340.description: Introduction: The extracts derived from red seaweed have shown characteristics that may reduce inflammation. The abovementioned effects can potentially provide positive outcomes in managing inflammatory illnesses, including arthritis, inflammatory bowel disease, and other skin problems.Aim: The polysaccharides were isolated from the Spyrida species. The water-soluble polysaccharides were extracted and fractionated from several Indian seaweeds (Red) using a simple, cost-effective approach.

pmc-11262453.title: Catheter Ablation of Persistent AF—Where are We Now?
pmc-11262453.creator: Louisa O’Neill, Benjamin De Becker, Maarten A.J. De Smet, Clara Francois, Jean-Benoit Le Polain De Waroux, Rene Tavernier, Mattias Duytschaever, Sebastien Knecht
pmc-11262453.description: Persistent atrial fibrillation (AF) is a diverse condition that includes various subtypes and underlying causes of arrhythmia. Progress made in catheter ablation technology in recent years has significantly enhanced the durability of ablation. Despite these advances however, the effectiveness of ablation in treating persistent AF is still relatively modest.

pmc-11406589.title: A case report of cardiopulmonary exercise testing and incentive spirometry-guided breathing pattern alteration for a severely tachypnoeic kyphoscoliotic patient undergoing major thoracic surgery for suspected lung malignancy
pmc-11406589.creator: Alan Wai-lun Wong, Carmen Ka-man Lam
pmc-11406589.description: A case report of a severely dyspnoeic kyphoscoliotic patient intended for an elective major thoracic surgery for suspected lung malignancy. With baseline near maximal breathing frequency and shallow breaths and poor lung mechanics, the first encountered anaesthetist considered this patient too high risk for lobectomy.

pmc-11429223.title: “It’s Different for Girls!” The Role of Anxiety, Physiological Arousal, and Subject Preferences in Primary School Children’s Math and Mental Rotation Performance
pmc-11429223.creator: Michelle Lennon-Maslin, Claudia Michaela Quaiser-Pohl, Jennifer LaCosse
pmc-11429223.description: (1) Background: This study examines the role of subjective anxiety (mathematics and spatial anxiety), along with physiological responses, in mathematics or math and mental rotation performance in 131 German primary school students (65 girls, 66 boys; Mean age = 8.73 years). (2) Method: Students’ preference for math vs. German and their subjective anxiety were assessed using standardized questionnaires.

pmc-11575210.title: The effect of a poly-herbal plant extract on the adhesion of Streptococcus mutans to tooth enamel
pmc-11575210.creator: Cynthia J Henley-Smith, Anna-Mari Kok, Francien S Botha, Chantelle Baker, Namrita Lall
pmc-11575210.description: BackgroundDental caries, also known as tooth decay or cavity formation, is one of the world’s most widespread dental conditions. It is a plaque-related infection caused mainly by Streptococcus mutans. People have relied on several plant species to treat oral infections; Heteropyxis natalensis, for example, has been used to treat toothache and gum infections.

pmc-12415249.title: Candidate Denisovan fossils identified through gene regulatory phenotyping
pmc-12415249.creator: Nadav Mishol, Gadi Herzlinger, Yoel Rak, Uzy Smilanksy, Liran Carmel, David Gokhman
pmc-12415249.description: SignificanceWe develop a phenotyping and scanning approach based on gene regulatory differences to identify potential Denisovans in the fossil record. We quantitatively compare genetically predicted phenotypes with morphological measurements and confirm that validated Denisovans are indeed identified through our approach.

pmc-12473537.title: The Application of Fulvic Acid Can Enhance the Performance of Rice Seedlings Under Low-Nitrogen Stress
pmc-12473537.creator: Ke Ma, Yuanyuan Zhou, Zexin Qi, Takuji Ohyama
pmc-12473537.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Fulvic acid’s potential to enhance plant growth has been recognized, but its effects on plant growth and nutrient uptake under nutrient stress remain unclear. This experiment investigated the effects of fulvic acid at concentrations of 0 mg L−1 (T1), 30 mg L−1 (T2), 60 mg L−1 (T3), 90 mg L−1 (T4), 120 mg L−1 (T5), and 150 mg L−1 (T6) on the growth performance of two rice varieties—Jikedao 654 (J 654) and Jiyang 100 (J 100)—under low-nitrogen stress in a hydroponic system.

pmc-12627963.title: Incidence and associated factors of delirium after hematopoietic stem cell transplantation: A retrospective study
pmc-12627963.creator: Koji Otsuki, Yusuke Okada, Tsutomu Takahashi, Kouhei Sato, Michiharu Nagahama, Ritsuro Suzuki, Masatoshi Inagaki
pmc-12627963.description: AimIn general, delirium is reported to have a higher incidence in hospitalized patients and is associated with a higher risk of mortality. However, there is insufficient knowledge of the incidence and prognostic impact of delirium following hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.

pmc-13413282.title: Direct Capture Methods Reveal Extensive Organohalide Chemical Space in Marine Environments
pmc-13413282.creator: Alexander Bogdanov, Douglas Sweeney, Melissa L. Carter, Kayla Martin, Elena Beckhaus, Paul R. Jensen
pmc-13413282.description: The vast majority of the ocean’s microbial natural product biosynthetic potential remains undescribed. To access this chemical diversity, we employed Small Molecule In Situ Resin Capture (SMIRC) across three ecologically distinct sites in San Diego, California. Using high-resolution LC-MS/MS, we detected spatial and temporal variability in the metabolomes captured.

pmc-13556141.title: Beyond the gene: isoform diversity as a key contributor to human brain disorders✰
pmc-13556141.creator: Yunlong Ma, Connor Jops, Michael J Gandal
pmc-13556141.description: The human brain exhibits exceptional transcriptomic complexity, with alternative splicing, promoter usage, and polyadenylation generating extensive transcript-isoform diversity. Isoform dysregulation is increasingly implicated in neurodevelopmental and psychiatric disorders (NPDs), yet the landscape, function, and genetic regulation of brain isoforms remain poorly understood due to limitations of short-read RNA sequencing.

pmc-13629249.title: Parents' Experiences of Psychosocial Support in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit: A Qualitative Study
pmc-13629249.creator: Hanna Seppänen, Eeva Talus, Ulla Sankilampi, Krista Koivula, Ilona Luoma, Tarja Pölkki
pmc-13629249.description: AimTo explore parents' experiences of psychosocial support in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU).DesignA qualitative descriptive study.MethodsThe study involved nine individual and three pair interviews; in total, 15 parents described their experiences of psychosocial support in the neonatal intensive care units. The data were analysed using inductive content analysis.

uslaw-usc-t10-s8102.title: 10 U.S.C. § 8102 — Regular Navy: retired flag officers on active duty
uslaw-usc-t10-s8102.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s8102.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 811 (Distribution In Grade). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Except in time of war or national emergency, not more than ten retired flag officers of the Regular Navy may be on active duty.
